sentences.text: 2 . In this revision petition, under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C., the petitioner has prayed for quashing the Complaint Petition, being C.R. Case No. 82/2023, pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Dibrugarh and the order dated 26.07.2023, passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Dibrugarh.
3. It is to be noted here that the said case has been registered on the basis of one complaint lodged by one Ashok Kr. Agarwal, on 18.07.2023.

It is also to be noted here that vide order dated 26.07.2023, the learned court below has taken cognizance against the petitioner and five others,
under Sections 406/420/463 of the IPC.
4. Perused the petition as well as the documents placed on record.
5. Let notice be issued to the respondent no. 2, within a week from today, returnable in 4 weeks, by registered post with A/D and also by usual process.
As Ms. Begum has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the State respondent, no formal notice is required to be issued.
However, extra requisite copy of the petition be furnished to the State respondent during the course of the day.

6. Mr. Choudhury, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has joined as Area Sales Manager, HDFC Bank, Guwahati Rukminigaon Branch since, 2019, and the loan was sanctioned on 10.02.2022, to the complainant.

Referring to the allegation made in the aforesaid complaint, Mr. Choudhury submits that no case under Section 406/420/463 of the IPC is made out Page No.# 3/3 against the present petitioner and the learned court below, vide order dated 26.07.2023, has committed illegality, in taking cognizance against the present petitioner and therefore, it is contended to allow the petition.
7. Having considered the submissions of learned counsel for both the parties, it is provided that till returnable date further proceeding of CR Case No. 82/2023, pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Dibrugarh, so far the present petitioner is concerned, stands stayed.
8. The registry shall call for the scanned copy of the record from the learned court below.
9. List the matter after 4 weeks.
